facts.fact: Ethio telecom's release states it signed on 4 February 2026 with Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Group a tripartite agreement under the Horizon Fiber Initiative for a terrestrial fibre corridor connecting Djibouti's landing stations, traversing Ethiopia, to Sudan's landing stations.
Ethio telecom's release states the agreement builds on a memorandum of understanding signed in Addis Ababa on 3 December 2024.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
